About Miguel’s Concrete Service

Local concrete work, done like it matters — because it does.

Miguel’s Concrete Service is based in Springfield, Tennessee, serving homeowners and businesses across the area with residential and commercial concrete work.

With about 11 years of concrete industry experience, Miguel handles everything from a brand-new driveway to a complete tear-out and replacement — with honest advice, clear communication, and a finish you can be proud of every time you pull in.

  • Free estimates before any work begins
  • New installations and complete replacements
  • Residential and commercial projects
  • Based in Springfield — serving about a 60-mile radius

What We Do

Concrete services for your home or business

From the driveway out front to the foundation underneath it all — one call covers it. Every project starts with a free estimate.

01 — Driveways

Concrete Driveways

Strong, clean driveways built for daily use — new installs and full replacements that lift your home’s curb appeal from day one.

02 — Walkways

Sidewalks

Safe, level sidewalks and walkways that replace cracked, uneven concrete and give your property a clean, finished edge.

03 — Outdoor Living

Patios

A solid patio built for cookouts, family time, and quiet evenings outside — sized and finished for how you actually live.

04 — Decorative

Stamped Concrete

The strength of concrete with the look of stone, brick, or tile. Decorative stamped finishes for patios, walkways, and more.

05 — Slabs

Slabs

Level, durable concrete slabs for sheds, garages, shops, additions, and more — poured right and ready for what goes on top.

06 — Foundations

Foundation Work

Foundation concrete work done with care from the ground up — the solid base every good build depends on.
